name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in heavily salted water until just short of al dente.
Meanwhile warm the oil, garlic and chilli in a wide pan over low heat until the garlic is pale gold.
Lift the pasta straight into the pan with a splash of its cooking water.
Toss hard for a minute so the oil and water emulsify into a glossy sauce.
Take off the heat, stir through the parsley, parmesan and lemon zest.
Season with salt and plenty of black pepper and serve at once.
